#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

class Unstoppable {
public:
    void solve(std::istream& in, std::ostream& out) {
        int n;
        long long b;
        in >> n >> b;
        std::vector<int> a(n);
        std::vector<int> c(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            in >> a[i];
            c[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
        }
        long long sum = 0;
        std::vector<int> array;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            sum += c[i];
            if (sum == 0) {
                array.push_back(std::abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
            }
        }
        sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        std::sort(array.begin(), array.end());
        for (int val : array) {
            sum += val;
            if (sum <= b) {
                count++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        out << count << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    Unstoppable solver;
    solver.solve(std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
